name: Lita
source:
Lita is a mysterious girl who they pick up at the circus after it was revealed that she was getting abused by the owner of the circus. Lita is a dancer and she takes this cat called [url=/c14725]Na[/url] around who she claims that she can talk to. Lita is very energetic and ends up being a maid in the Ashley family and shows great skill in all the tasks that she is being given by her tutor [url=/c14729]Nola[/url].

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/16/rondo-leaflet-review/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
